name: Cereal with Fruit
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ½ lb. dates, stoned, and cut in pieces

steps: Mix cereal, salt, and cold water; add to boiling water placed on front of range.
Boil five minutes, steam in double boiler thirty minutes; stir in dates, and serve with cream.
To serve for breakfast, or as a simple dessert.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
